feeds.title: Austine 101 Magazine
feeds.description: Do you love live music? Austin 101 Magazine has thousands of concert photos from Austin for you all - Photos, music and many other cool kinds of stuff are featured in its blog, check it out. It features reviews, music, festivals, films and more in the blog and talks about various genres in each heading.

feeds.title: The Cosmic Clash
feeds.description: The Cosmic Clash was born in 2012 and features a treasure trove of live videos, interviews, and photographs from shows ranging from his El Paso post-punk roots mixing with bands like At the Drive-In, Attempted Erns, V.B.F., Sicteens and Texas Exiles to more contemporary acts in Austin, Los Angeles, and El Paso.

feeds.title: Austin Monthly » Music
feeds.description: Austin Monthly serves to celebrate and examine the free-spirited, ground-breaking, and creative ethos of the evolving city. Austin Monthly delivers a guide to the best of the city along with thought-provoking reads on the issues, trends, ideas and people catalyzing the city's transformation and celebrations of those that champion the city's distinct culture and soul. Read about songwriters, music and much more in Austin, in the Music section.

feeds.title: Rancho Alegre
feeds.description: Rancho Alegre Radio is a federally-recognized nonprofit organization dedicated to preserving and promoting Conjunto music. To fulfill this mission, our projects include digitizing recordings, interviewing legendary and up-and-coming artists, maintaining and constructing a historical record of Tejano and Conjunto music, speaking to schools and universities, and connecting artists with professional and business services.

feeds.title: Rockstar Magazine
feeds.description: Rockstar covers Austin's music scene monthly with articles on the local music scene and touring artists. Ranging from Rock to Hip Hop, Metal, Funk, to Country, Rockstar covers all genres of music. Our Publisher is currently working on the 40th Issue of Rockstar and issue # 157 overall publication.

feeds.title: KUTX
feeds.description: Launched in 2013 by Austin's NPR station KUT, KUTX is a full-time music service, broadcasting from the University of Texas. Our goal is to help you fall in love with Austin music. KUTX is more than a radio station. We're the global destination for The Austin Music Experience. From our social media channels to performances in our state-of-the-art Studio 1A, to our family-friendly Rock the Park concert series, we have a way for everyone to stay connected to Austin music.

feeds.title: Kid with a Vinyl
feeds.description: Kid with a vinyl is an independent blog devoted to sharing new music from around the world. Since 2014, our posts have spanned countless genres and micro-genres like chillwave, psych rock, and glitch pop. we do not 'grade' music with numerical ratings or stars, if we write about it, we hold it in high regard.

feeds.title: Austin City Limits
feeds.description: Austin City Limits is a music performance television show that appears weekly on PBS The show showcases popular music legends and innovators from every genre. ACL is the longest-running music program in television history, and the only television show to have been awarded the National Medal of the Arts.

feeds.title: Frontman Philosophy
feeds.description: Frontman Philosophy by Lev Baker will give you a unique perspective on your instrument and playing style to help you become a better musician. Uncover sound answer to all questions big and small that a guitarist, bassist, drummer, or sound engineer may have.

feeds.title: Austin Texas Music Life
feeds.description: Let's see if Austin is the Capitol for music in Texas. I will cover many different genres of music and different venues from underground jazz bars to this year's South by Southwest concert. I will give detail about the different venue's atmospheres, explaining if it is more of a nightclub, concert, or just a restaurant with live music.

feeds.title: Ovrld | The Austin Music Blog
feeds.description: We provide songs, interviews, reviews, podcasts and more, with hopes to expand over time to include even more ways for you to explore Austin music. Our goal is to help you sift through the vibrant music scene here to find whatever it is you're looking for. Whether you're an Austinite looking for a cool concert this weekend, or you've never been to the music capital of the world but want to get the latest on what's happening here, we are here for you.

feeds.title: Austin.com » Music
feeds.description: Austin.com is a unique local media network fashioned from the ground up with the goal of making Austin, Texas a more welcoming, connected, friendly community for everyone who lives here, wants to live here, is visiting, or just can't get enough ATX. Discover some of the best Austin bands, whether it's rock, hip-hop, country, blues, or electronic.

feeds.title: Austin Chamber Music Center Blog
feeds.description: The Austin Chamber Music Center creates chamber music experiences that connect, educate, and inspire our community. We aim to provide an avenue for professional musicians to interact with each other and communicate their enthusiasm for chamber music to students and audiences through paid teaching and performance opportunities.

feeds.title: Side One Track One » Music
feeds.description: Side One Track One is a music and film blog based in Austin, Texas. It was brought into the world by John Laird on August 9, 2006. Their music blog has tracks and playlists for their radio and website. They also have a podcast that has amazing insights.
